title: White Paper - Part 3 of 4 - Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 3: Data, Validation Ledger, and Falsification Protocol
description: Presents a structured validation ledger for Energy-Flow Cosmology (102 registered tests), two sealed blind predictions with cryptographic provenance, and a pre-registered falsification protocol for Stage-IV surveys. Reports a persistent but non-detection growth-sector signal (αL2 = −1.00 ± 0.46, ΔAIC = −2.91) and defines sharp kill criteria that would compel abandoning EFC.

growth_sector_signal.description: Persistent directional signal inferred from growth-sector validation runs; not a detection.

delta_AIC.description: Model comparison indicator for EFC relative to the ΛCDM baseline in the growth sector.

bao_DH_over_rd_z1p0_EFC_LCDM.description: Sealed Prediction 1 BAO radial distance ratio at z=1.0, showing a 3.1σ deviation from ΛCDM.

bao_DH_over_rd_z0p7_EFC_LCDM.description: Sealed Prediction 1 BAO radial distance ratio at z=0.7, a 2.3σ deviation from ΛCDM.

fsigma8_z0p7_EFC_LCDM.description: Sealed Prediction 1 growth-rate amplitude at z=0.7, a 2.0σ deviation from ΛCDM.

crossover_redshift.description: Predicted growth crossover redshift (from Sealed Prediction 1) to be tested by DESI DR2 ELG.

kill_criterion_alpha_threshold.description: Pre-registered kill threshold for the growth-sector coupling; if met with µ=Σ=1 across probes, EFC is falsified.

key_results.main_finding: A pre-registered validation ledger finds a persistent growth-sector signal αL2 = −1.00 ± 0.46 (2.20σ; ΔAIC = −2.91) with 7/7 LOO robustness, while defining sealed predictions and sharp falsification criteria for Stage-IV tests.
datasets_used: DESI (transfer checks; Stage-IV target for DR2 ELG)

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed on 2026-02-18 (hash prefix 7a850cfa58477701): with parameters frozen (αL2 = −0.689), predict D_H/r_d(z=1.0)=16.527, D_H/r_d(z=0.7)=19.797, fσ8(z=0.7)=0.430, and a growth crossover at z_cross = 2.042.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 ELG growth and BAO/RSD measurements; cross-check with Euclid/Rubin weak-lensing and RSD.

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed on 2026-02-21 (hash prefix dbccda150abca0e7): updated parameter freeze αL2 = −0.702 from a second NUTS cycle.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Same Stage-IV BAO+RSD and growth data streams (DESI, Euclid, Rubin LSST) under the sealed-parameter protocol.

kill_criteria: KC1: If µ(k,z) = 1 and Σ(k,z) = 1 within measurement precision across all probes simultaneously, and the combined constraint yields |αL2| < 0.1 at 3σ, then EFC is falsified (growth sector).

KC2: If fσ8(z) is monotonically increasing for z < 2 (no growth suppression), or if the DESI DR2 ELG measurement of the crossover redshift satisfies |z_cross − 2.042| > 3σ, then EFC is falsified (crossover prediction).
